passages.text: “There are these two things. What two? Cleaning your own mind, and not grasping at anything in the world. These are the two things.”

When an astute, competent true person has two qualities they keep themselves healthy and whole. They don’t deserve to be blamed and criticized by sensible people, and they brim with much merit. What two? After examining and scrutinizing, they criticize those deserving of criticism and they praise those deserving of praise.
passages.note: judging others fairly before praising or blaming
